title: The 10 Best Running Shoes
metaDescription: Our 10 picks for running shoes, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at running shoes using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Brooks Ghost 17
products.blurb: Key specs: Neutral, DNA Loft v3 midsole, 10mm drop (Brooks spec).
strengths: Balanced, predictable ride for most paces
limitations: Not as soft as max-cushion shoes
Unexciting for tempo runs
About 10 oz in men's sizes

products.name: HOKA Clifton 11
products.blurb: Key specs: Neutral, Maximum cushioning, MetaRocker geometry.
strengths: Soft, high-stack cushioning without much weight
MetaRocker geometry makes easy miles feel smooth
Neutral design suits most runners who don't overpronate
limitations: Compressed EVA midsoles lose bounce sooner than premium foams
Not designed for fast speedwork
Tall stack can feel less stable on tight corners

products.name: ASICS Gel-Nimbus 27
products.blurb: Key specs: Neutral, Maximum cushioning, FF BLAST PLUS ECO + PureGEL.
strengths: Comfortable knit upper for long runs
limitations: Heavier than lighter cushioned shoes
Premium price
Too soft for runners who like ground feel

products.name: ASICS Novablast 5
products.blurb: Key specs: Neutral, FF BLAST MAX midsole, 8mm drop (ASICS spec).
strengths: Good mix of easy-day and up-tempo use
limitations: Less stable than firmer shoes
Not for runners needing support
Bounce can feel less controlled on corners

products.name: Brooks Adrenaline GTS 24
products.blurb: Key specs: Stability (GuideRails), DNA Loft v3 midsole, 12mm drop (Brooks spec).
limitations: 12mm drop is high for runners preferring a flatter shoe
Version 25 has replaced it, so stock varies
Support may feel unnecessary for neutral runners

products.name: ASICS Gel-Kayano 31
products.blurb: Key specs: Stability (4D Guidance System), FF BLAST PLUS ECO + PureGEL, 10mm drop (ASICS spec).
strengths: Plenty of cushioning for long runs
limitations: About 10.7 oz (ASICS spec), heavy
Premium price
Version 32 is now available, so colors vary

products.name: Nike Pegasus 41
products.blurb: Key specs: Neutral, ReactX foam with Air Zoom units, Engineered mesh upper.
strengths: Versatile for easy and moderate runs
limitations: Firmer than max-cushion shoes
Narrower fit than Brooks and HOKA
Many lifestyle variants make listings confusing
features: ReactX foam with Air Zoom units

products.name: Saucony Ride 18
products.blurb: Key specs: Neutral, Moderate-to-high cushioning, 8mm offset (Saucony spec).
limitations: Less plush than max-cushion shoes
The Ride 19 is now available, so stock varies
Some colorways listed as fashion sneakers

products.name: HOKA Bondi 9
products.blurb: Key specs: Neutral, Maximum cushioning, Supercritical EVA midsole.
strengths: Stable wide base for a tall shoe
limitations: Heavy and bulky for faster running
Tall stack feels disconnected from the ground
Firmer than some expect for its size

products.name: Brooks Glycerin Flex (Women's)
products.blurb: Key specs: Neutral, Maximum cushioning, 6mm drop (Brooks spec).
strengths: About 8 oz, light for a max-cushion shoe
6mm drop suits runners who prefer a flatter feel
Nitrogen-infused foam is soft and comfortable
limitations: Lower drop can strain calves if you're used to 10-12mm shoes
Newer model with little long-term durability data
Knit uppers run warmer and less structured than mesh

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
